The // per-item "..." action button is reproduced inline with the source's // exact classes/data-slot instead of a component. // - side/align on the DropdownMenu content is hardcoded to the desktop // values ("right"/"start") since isMobile isn't available; source // switches to "bottom"/"end" on mobile via useSidebar(). import SidebarGroup from "../../components/ui/sidebar/group.marko"; import SidebarGroupLabel from "../../components/ui/sidebar/group-label.marko"; import SidebarMenu from "../../components/ui/sidebar/menu.marko"; import SidebarMenuItem from "../../components/ui/sidebar/menu-item.marko"; import SidebarMenuButton from "../../components/ui/sidebar/menu-button.marko"; import DropdownMenu from "../../components/ui/dropdown-menu/dropdown-menu.marko"; import { cn } from "../../lib/utils.ts"; export interface DocumentItem { name: string; url: string; /** Inner SVG markup (24x24 tabler-icon paths), rendered raw via $!{}. */ icon: string; } export interface Input { items: DocumentItem[]; class?: string; } Documents item.name> ${item.name} <@trigger|props|> <@item> Open <@item> Share <@item type="separator"/> <@item danger> Delete More
